notes.title: Video Novel
notes.notes:
Hi,
Great to see you all again! It's been a while, huh?

I just wanted to pop in to let you all know our Video version of Runeous has changed homes. You can find it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=luqenHG4V4g

Hope you all enjoy! ^^

notes.title: Achievements and Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

I hope you've all been enjoying Runeous!

We've been working on adding in achievements to the game. This is partly the reason why the update is so large, in order for achievements to work we've had to restructure the games files.

Along with this update we've also made the resolution slightly larger and it's now a little more 'rectangular' and a little less 'square'

All the best,

The Novel Tea Team.

notes.title: We're Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you to all of you who helped to greenlight Runeous on Steam, we couldn't have done it without you.

Both Mac and PC builds are now available for download and it's totally FREE!
If you encounter any bugs, please do let us know!

Please keep an eye out for all the extra goodies we'll be uploading throughout the next week ;)


_____________________________________

A special thanks to Sapphire Dragon for all their help getting us set up and for the Mac build!

Thank you to jay_rab for supporting the team through development!
